verdict.rationale: Insomnia's official GitHub repository is public and licensed under Apache-2.0, confirmed by the LICENSE file and README, satisfying the ability to read the source under an open license. An older 2016 community comment calling it 'not open source' is outdated and predates the project's open-sourcing, so it does not concretely contradict the current documented license. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of source completeness/currency and more recent community confirmation of the open-source status.
